subject: Clearline Payments — unexpected prefetch drift and availability delta
messages:
From: Anya Sokol <anya.sokol@clearline-payments.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Clearline Payments Support <support@clearline-payments.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intermittent 503s during prefetch window (impacting checkout)

Marcus —

We observed a spike of 503s during our morning checkout surge today that looks correlated with the prefetch stage. Timeline below (UTC):
- 2026-10-30 15:43:21 — first elevated 503 rate
- 2026-10-30 15:51:07 — peak 503s (~6% of requests)
- 2026-10-30 16:05:34 — rates returned to baseline

Impact: ~2.8k failed checkout attempts over the 22-minute window; customers saw a payment modal error. This behaviour repeats on two consecutive days at similar local times.

We need:
1) confirmation of whether this meets the SLA availability delta definition
2) a copy of the raw traces/logs you used to assess the window if there's any internal gating logic
3) an estimated timeline for a postmortem and any credit eligibility evaluation

I've attached a short HAR and a quick summary CSV. We can share more logs if you need them.

Thanks — Anya
Anya Sokol
Director, Core Payments
Clearline Payments

Attachments: clearline_sample.har (HAR snippet), impact_summary.csv (CSV)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com>
To: Anya Sokol <anya.sokol@clearline-payments.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent 503s during prefetch window (impacting checkout)

Hi Anya — thanks for the details and attachments. Sorry for the impact this morning. We're opening a formal incident ticket on our side and will scope the window immediately. Quick notes/asks so we can move fast:

- Can you confirm whether the 2.8k failed checkouts were clustered on a single tenant ID or spread across multiple merchant IDs? That helps with apportionment.
- Please upload the full log bundle (all traces from 15:30–16:15 UTC) to the shared transfer link you prefer; we may need request-level traces.
- We'll run our prefetch/kvcache telemetry to check for drift, cache-trim events, and any autoscaler activity overlapping the window.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Irene will pull KV/cache eviction and prefetch telemetry and correlate tokenization/compile failures.
- Laura will calculate availability delta against your contracted SLO and scope potential compensation paths.
- We'll propose an RCA meeting for 10/31; does 11:00 PT work for you?

We aim to provide an initial impact summary by EOD today and a credit eligibility estimate within 5 business days once we have the full traces.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Senior Technical Account Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment requested: clearline_logs_20261030.tar.gz (log bundle)
From: Anya Sokol <anya.sokol@clearline-payments.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Clearline Payments Support <support@clearline-payments.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T12:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent 503s during prefetch window (impacting checkout)

Marcus —

Thanks. We uploaded the full bundle to the SFTP you provided (file: clearline_logs_20261030.tar.gz). The failures were concentrated on two merchant IDs (merchant_abc and merchant_def), ~65% / ~25% split; remainder were singletons. Traffic shape: spike starts as a prefetch-heavy burst (many concurrent cold sequences), then transitions into normal generation traffic.

We absolutely want the RCA meeting on 10/31 at 11:00 PT. Please consider this a formal SLA claim — Clearline will expect an evaluation of credit eligibility and a postmortem that addresses: root cause, why prefetch logic didn't degrade gracefully, and mitigations to prevent recurrence (we run Black Friday tests soon).

Also tagging that we have an internal compliance audit and will need signed evidence that telemetry used in the adjudication is unaltered.

Anya

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood-inference.com>
To: Anya Sokol <anya.sokol@clearline-payments.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-10-31T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent 503s during prefetch window (impacting checkout)

Anya —

Thank you for the upload and the clarifying traffic breakdown. Quick status update from Redwood's investigation team (initial triage):

What we found so far
- KV prefetch task queue experienced a backlog between 15:41–15:58 UTC due to a short-lived compile stall in a subset of worker shards; that increased latency and pushed some prefetch attempts past timeout thresholds, producing 503s at the caller layer.
- The behaviour disproportionately affected two merchant IDs as you reported due to higher concurrency on cold sequences.
- No config or customer request changes were detected from Clearline's tenant during the window.

Planned next steps
- We will run a full evidence pull and record integrity hash of: request traces, compile logs, autoscaler events, and KV eviction metrics. We will provide the integrity hashes and the raw bundle to your SFTP for audit.
- Laura will produce a preliminary availability delta calculation and potential compensatory amount by 11/07 (five business days). If the window meets SLA entitlement criteria, we will propose pro-rata credit options.
- RCA meeting confirmed for 2026-10-31 11:00 PT. Zoom invite attached to calendar.

We appreciate the heads up about your Black Friday run; we'll prioritize the mitigation plan.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Sr. Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: prefetch-traces-20261030.har (trace summary)
